card.name: Linking words in combination regimens
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'and', 'with', 'vs' or '/' right after a drug name in combination cancer regimens, especially lenalidomide, pomalidomide, rituximab or bortezomib, where the next partner drug (dexamethasone, rituximab) is expected.

modes.label: Joiner after partner drug
modes.description: 'and' or 'with' directly after a drug name, before the next drug in the regimen.
modes.example: When administered in combination with lenalidomide<< and>> dexamethasone, discontinue

modes.label: Slash or versus between arms
modes.description: A slash or 'vs' between drug names naming trial arms or regimens.
